_comment: Baseline for check-body-completeness.mjs, keyed check -> bucket -> count. The gate fires on GROWTH in a bucket or on ANY NEW bucket. Shrink these numbers as the backlog is worked off; never raise one without saying why here and in the commit message.  CHAMBER_SIZE_MISMATCH is keyed state|direction, because the two directions need OPPOSITE fixes. Seeded 2026-11-14 at 19 mismatches out of the 514 chambers that state a size. 948 of 1,462 chambers state NO size (NULL, or the 0 sentinel that 296 of them carry) and are invisible to this check — that is the honest limit of its reach, not a clean result.    OFFICES > DISTINCT PEOPLE — South Portland s signature, and the ones most likely to be real defects:     ca|too_many  Santa Clarita City Council: states 5, we hold 8 offices, FIVE distinct people. Three office rows hold nobody. CLAUDE.md already records a Santa Clarita address returning two nameless cards; this is very likely the same three rows. NOT investigated here.     ma|too_many  Cambridge City Council: states 9, we hold 11, TEN people.    OFFICES = DISTINCT PEOPLE — Bangor s shape. Either official_count is wrong or a seat is mistitled; only the charter settles which, and a count being right is not the body being right:     ca|too_many  El Monte (6/7), Inglewood (4/5), Pasadena (7/8)     ga|too_many  Fulton County Elected Officials (4/5), DeKalb County Elected Officials (3/4)     tn|too_many  Nashville Metropolitan Council (40/41)     tx|too_many  Blue Ridge (5/6), Weston (5/6), Josephine (5/6), Lowry Crossing (5/9)     us|too_many  US Attorney General (1/2) and Secretary of Homeland Security (1/2) — two office rows for one post each; likely an outgoing/incoming pair rather than a duplicate. Buckets as us because federal chambers carry no state.    TOO FEW — the body has seats we do not hold. Lewiston s shape:     me|too_few   Lewiston Public Schools School Committee: charter says 9, we hold 8. The ninth is a city councillor the council appoints; CC_0429 set official_count to 9 precisely so this would be countable. Open, dated 2026-11-14 — see backend/data/seed-me-municipal-2026/ROSTERS.md R9l.     sc|too_few   Columbia (7/6), Myrtle Beach (7/6)     tx|too_few   Plano (9/8)     al|too_few   Alabama State Board of Education (9/8)  DISTRICT_WITHOUT_OFFICE is keyed state|district_type. Seeded 2026-11-14 at 3,207 of 11,403 districts. 3,053 of those are COUNTY rows: 21 states hold no county offices at all and no state has a complete county tier. Keying on state|district_type is what lets an unseeded state sit still while a wave that creates an unseated office in it fires immediately. me|COUNTY 16 is the finding that prompted this gate — every Maine county is a district with a polygon and zero offices, found by CC_0428 s own reachability gate failing (ROSTERS.md R9k). It is NOT a defect to fix by deleting; it is a tier nobody has seeded.  WATCH THESE TWO: 25|LOCAL 1 and 25|SCHOOL 1 are Massachusetts districts carrying the FIPS code 25 where every other row carries USPS. The state key is deliberately NOT normalised, because mapping 25 -> ma here would launder exactly the class of defect this gate exists to surface. Fixing those two rows should REMOVE both buckets, not lower them.  2026-11-14 (CC_0430): me|too_few (was 1) REMOVED, not lowered -- Lewiston School Committee now holds 9 offices against its official_count of 9. The ninth seat (City Council Representative, is_appointed_position = true) was created and seated with Ward 3 Councilor Scott A. Harriman, sourced from the school committee page roster and the city s own board-and-committee appointment listing. Verified on prod: 9 offices, 9 distinct current holders, 0 empty seats, and the 238 unflagged drift baseline unmoved. Any reappearance should fire as a NEW bucket. ** NOTE the January 2027 follow-up: this seat is re-elected ANNUALLY and the council s term for it expires 2027-01-04, so if the council elects a different member this bucket does not move -- the HOLDER changes and nothing here notices.**
